x_note: The explicit acceptance record for proposal.valid.json. accepted_by is a CALLER-SUPPLIED AUDIT LABEL only (ADR-0018, same convention as ResolvedImageIdentityV1.resolved_by) -- DServer performs no authentication of it. materialized_dmap_ref.id uses canonical_dmap_id's length-prefixed encoding (independent review v2, identifier-composition audit: 'dmap:' + '<len>:<project_id>' + '<len>:<application_id>', concatenated with no separator between the two length-prefixed components -- unambiguous regardless of what characters project_id/application_id themselves contain, e.g. the literal ':' inside 'app:ddeploy-lab'). materialized_dmap_ref.digest is the SAME value recompute_dmap_digest produces for the CanonicalDMapV1 DServer materializes from this proposal's placements (dmap_id/revision are DServer-owned, never proposal-supplied). operational_projection_ref.operational_dgraph_id is DELIBERATELY not equal to either canonical dgraph_ref.id or a legacy 'dgraph:<project_id>' id -- see ADR-0018's authorization-separation section.
